faqs.question: Is it difficult to get admission at NIFT Delhi?
faqs.answer: NIFT Delhi is one of the top Design institutes in India. It is the only institute in India to be ranked on the list of top 20 Design colleges, internationally. Getting admission to NIFT Delhi is every aspirant's dream. However, only a few are able to get admission to NIFTs, as the NIFT entrance exam it is not very easy to crack it. Candidates aspiring for NIFT Delhi need to cover important aspects such as Case Study, Analytical and Logical Ability, GK and Current Affairs, Quantitative Ability, Communication Ability and English Comprehension to crack the NIFT entrance exam. So, yes NIFT is difficult to get but with the rit approach and preparation, it is not impossible to crack the NIFT entrance test.

faqs.question: What are the courses offered at NIFT Delhi?
faqs.answer: The National Institute of Fashion Technology offers B.Des and B.FTech courses at the undergraduate level. NIFT Delhi offers M.Des, MFM and M.FTech courses at the postgraduate level. Apart from the UG and PG courses, NIFT Delhi also offers a list of UG Diploma and Continuing Education (CE) short-term programmes with a course duration ranging between three months and one year depending on the course.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of pursuing B.Des from NIFT Delhi?
faqs.answer:
BDes from NIFT Delhi can be worth pursuing due to its reputation in fashion industry. Below mentioned are the benefits of choosing BDes from NIFT Delhi:
NIFT Delhi has been ranked 1 by The Week, India Today and Outlook in 2024 under the 'Fashion Design' category.
It has well-qualified faculty with years of experience. 
NIFT Delhi offers financial assistance through Means-Cum-Merit scheme to the students from lower income background.
The institute offers internship programs with leading fashion brands and designers.
Top recruiters at NIFT Delhi include Myntra, Nike, Fabindia, etc. The highest package offered to the NIFT students in 2024 stood up to INR 12 - INR 15 LPA.

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for B.Des programme at NIFT Delhi?

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: National Institute of Fashion Technology isn't for everyone.

review_content.Placements: A lot of MNCs come to the college every year, and many students get placed, but it's a hard competition. The highest package is 16 LPA to 18 LPA, while the average is 7 LPA to 8 LPA. Companies like Aditya Birla, L&T, etc., hire students. Internships depend on your skills. I have seen people working as interns in H&M as well as unemployed.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good, with stone walls and AC labs. There are two divisions of the college, new and old. The new one has better classrooms, while the old one needs a bit of refurbishing. The canteen and water supply aren't great, and there's only a girls' hostel, no boys' hostel available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Proud of my decision of choosing to come here.

review_content.Placements: Usually, all the students get placed. Either through college placements, faculty's help, or through connections/college exposure. The highest package is 60k p/m and the lowest package is 20k p/m. Fashion designer, analyst, stylist, and forecaster are the roles offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: Provides Wi-Fi, labs, smart classrooms, 3D printers, the highest technologies, library, hostels for girls only, play areas, etc. The faculty members also stay here till 7 p.m., so it’s usually good for asking doubts and seeking help. Quality and cleanliness are really good here.

reviews_list.batch_info: Certificate in Designing and Styling for Indian Fashion - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the designing department but not with the styling department.

review_content.Placements: Since it was a certificate course, they didn’t provide placements, which didn’t make sense because it was still from one of the most reputed colleges in India. Even if they couldn’t provide placement opportunities, the least they could have done was to give contacts for internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities provided during the course were exceptional, as a design college should offer. Labs, classrooms, you name it. The library in the college was top-notch, one of the very best I had experienced. Campus life was pretty chill. But, the certificate course students were highly segregated from the regular courses, which created a sense of disconnection.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Des. in Textile Design - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Best college for Textile design.

review_content.Placements: NIFT Delhi is a very popular and very good college in India. Our NIFT Delhi gives 99% placements and internship facilities. Placements are give according to your studies. Very good quality hostels available. All types of references books available in our library. Canteen and food court are good to go. High-speed internet facilities available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Des. in Leather Design - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Our college teachers are very helpful and various facilities are available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.FTech. in Apparel Production - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Good course and curriculum, best campus life.

review_content.Placements: At least half of the batch got placed with either PPO or campus placement drive. The package offered is up to 6 LPA-7.5 LPA. paragraphs: NIFT Delhi admission criteriais completely entrance-based. Candidates who meet the course-specific eligibility criteria can take the NIFT entrance exam to get a seat in the desired programme. The admission process broadly involves online registration, entrance test, result declaration, counselling and seat allotment.
STEP 1: NIFT Delhi Application Process 2025

Candidates who fulfil the course-specific eligibility criteria can fill out the application form. Eligible students can fill out the application form through the NIFT official website (nift.ac.in/niftadmissions.in/nift.ac.in/admission).
STEP 2: Appear for the Entrance Exam

In the next step, the applicant has to appear for theNIFT Entrance Exam. This entrance test is conducted in two parts: written exams and situation tests/personal interviews. Moreover, the written exam is conducted in online mode. The situation test is in offline mode and the personal interview is in online mode.
STEP 3: Release of Cutoff List
After the selection rounds, the institute releases thecutoff list. The cutoff marks vary from one course to another.
STEP 4: NIFT Counselling

Candidates with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks become eligible for counselling. During counselling, a seat allotment procedure is carried out. The complete schedule regarding the same shall be available on the NIFT official website.
STEP 5: Document Verification & Payment of NIFT Delhi Fees
After seat allotment, candidates may have to submit the important documents at the institute. Along with this, candidates are asked to pay some amount of fees as well for seat confirmation.

The components included in theNIFT Delhi feeare tuition fee, hostel fees, etc. Some components are paid every semester, while some are one-time. Aspirants must pay the fee within the specified time to avoid cancellation of admission. Check below theNIFT Delhi fee:

faqs.question: Is it difficult to get admission at NIFT Delhi?
faqs.answer: NIFT Delhi is one of the top Design institutes in India. It is the only institute in India to be ranked on the list of top 20 Design colleges, internationally. Getting admission to NIFT Delhi is every aspirant's dream. However, only a few are able to get admission to NIFTs, as the NIFT entrance exam it is not very easy to crack it. Candidates aspiring for NIFT Delhi need to cover important aspects such as Case Study, Analytical and Logical Ability, GK and Current Affairs, Quantitative Ability, Communication Ability and English Comprehension to crack the NIFT entrance exam. So, yes NIFT is difficult to get but with the rit approach and preparation, it is not impossible to crack the NIFT entrance test.

Top recruiting firms include Titan, Fabindia, Fossil and HiDesign. About 70% of students got internships with companies like Tommy Hilfiger, Louis Vuitton and Michael Kors. Roles range from accessory designers to product developers and merchandisers.
content.Infrastructure: NIFT Bangalore offers excellent infrastructure for accessory design courses. The department has modern labs, spacious classrooms and a well-equipped library with relevant resources. Wi-Fi connectivity has high-speed throughout the campus. Hostel facilities are satisfactory with clean accommodation and adequate facilities. Messes and canteens provide decent quality food and medical facilities are readily available on campus. Additional, sports and games facilities promote extracurricular activities and overall well-being.

hostel.description: National Institute of Fashion Technology, Bangalore does not provide hostel facility for boys. Hostel accommodation is provided only during the first year of the course. 2nd, 3rd, and 4th-year girl students would be accommodated in hostel depending on the availability of rooms.  All the hostel are Wi-Fi enabled and have water purifier units, solar panels, housekeeping service and gym. Rooms are well ventilated and are available on triple sharing basis.

library.description: The Resource Centre (RC) at National Institute of Fashion Technology, Bangalore is considered as a repository of information for both students, faculty, and staff. RCs acquire print, electronic and other non-print learning resources throughout the year. Offers online information services to its members as it uses cloud-based integrated multi-location library management database e-Granthalaya of the National Informatics Centre (NIC). Resource Sharing has been one the key practices of RC, reading materials including books and periodicals in print are borrowed and photocopies /electronic copies of documents are arranged from other libraries through institutional memberships with other libraries.

reviews.review_heading: Nift is amazing I will teach not only in studies but also the quality of life
reviews.review_text: There are labs and costly machine wifi all over campus library. Mess and hostel is really good. Hostel room wifi is there in hostel. All the facilities are good you will get various things here and this campus will promote all the cultural activities. It feels amazing.

reviews.review_heading: My experience in NIFT has opened my mind.
reviews.review_text: The college isn't very big; our auditorium is a little smaller compared to other branches, but our college is one of the top three NIFTs that have good placements, equipment, and faculty, which is a great advantage. I don't know much about the hostel, but as far as I've heard, the rooms are small, and you have to share with a roommate that they assign to you. There's a curfew at 9:30, and after the first year, you need to vacate.

reviews.review_heading: The best opportunity to enter the fashion industry is through college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is like any other hostel you'll find in college, although the infrastructure isn't very good and seems old. The rooms are kept clean and cleaned regularly as well. You have to share with 3 or four people, depending on what room you get. Obviously, it's a different experience when it comes to having fun with your friends.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bachelors in Textile Design from the NIFT Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: NIFT Bangalore had a good infrastructure for textile design. There were proper labs with all types of necessary machines for the students hands-on practice. At the college, all kinds of facilities were available for the students. The college has developed labs, a library, a canteen, Wi-Fi, sports, medical, etc. facilities for the students. A hostel was also provided to the students. The food was good to eat.

reviews.review_heading: NIFT Bangalore is an excellent institution.
reviews.review_text: NIFT Bangalore offers excellent infrastructure for accessory design courses. The department has modern labs, spacious classrooms and a well-equipped library with relevant resources. Wi-Fi connectivity has high-speed throughout the campus. Hostel facilities are satisfactory with clean accommodation and adequate facilities. Messes and canteens provide decent quality food and medical facilities are readily available on campus. Additional, sports and games facilities promote extracurricular activiti...

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Fashion Technology, Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: There is a well-stocked library with a wide range of books, journals, and other study materials available for the students. There is Wi-Fi facility available for the students in classrooms as well as on the campus. There are various types of games available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: The place where dreams get fulfilled.
reviews.review_text:
In the academic area, we have a classroom, library, lab, and seminar hall. In the hostel, we have single- and double-occupancy rooms. We have a common room where there is a TV and games.
We have a mess with vegetarian and non-vegetarian options available. We are also provided with a laundry facility.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Fashion Technology, Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides average facilities. The Wi-Fi facility is not good. Classrooms are old. They provide sports and games facilities. A playground is not available in our college. The college should improve.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has excellent faculty members who shape the industry.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi doesn't work most of the time. The infrastructure for the course is good. The library has a lot of useful research books and fashion magazines. There are many computer labs. The hostel is congested though. The room is supposed to be for 2 students but has 3 students in it.

reviews.review_heading: Our college needs genuine Improvement.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi hardly works, and when it does, the connectivity is so less. The classrooms are so less technically equipped. The tables always hurt students, they and have caused a lot of bruises and bleeding. The hostel facility does not provide what it promises, and the rooms require renovation. Mess food is not up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has very good and experienced faculty members with top-notch infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is right up there, with attractive visuals on every wall that catch the eye. The canteen food while is a little less on the quantity side, the quality side is off the charts. They have a cycle of meals, and on Fridays the current catering company offers a special meal, like ghee dosa, chappati, chicken, etc. The basketball court is my personal favorite part of the college along with this central amphitheater where most performances happen.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has potential to improve.

reviews.review_heading: The obstacles come to students' way very often, but they learn to overcome it.
reviews.review_text: In this college, the hostel is good, security is tight, food is average, often spicy, but there is good thali available. The security is friendly, the warden checks in for attendance every day, and overall safety is guaranteed. The security is strict about timings.

reviews.review_heading: It is costly for nothing, but the faculty members are friendly.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is conjusted. There are no air-conditioners in classrooms and broken chairs. The hostel infrastructure is not that great, and we shared a 2 people room with 3. reviews.review_heading: One of the finest place to study fashion.
reviews.review_text: We have unlimited Wi-Fi in the campus. Hostel is only for girls. We have Mac labs and labs for pattern making and garment construction. Library is available for 6 days a week. Online library is there too. Food quality in the mess is average. We have basketball court, badminton court and other sports and games. hostel_campus.college_name: NIFT Mumbai Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Great faculty, good education, but the infrastructure and sourcing can be challenging.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure is good. I personally feel they should have more machines. During juries, there is a lot of chaos as both the juniors and seniors need them. The college is in Navi Mumbai. It becomes very difficult to source materials as we have to travel to Mumbai. I wish the college was in Mumbai itself. We would have had more exposure. As for the hostel, it’s decent, but the only downside is the hostel food, which is very bad.

reviews.review_heading: NIFT Mumbai in a nutshell.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by NIFT are good. The hostel rooms are spacious and well-equipped. Food, on the other hand, is average. The classrooms and labs are well-equipped and add to the experience of doing everything hands-on and not just relying on presentations.

reviews.review_heading: Overall good experience, just not worth the fees we pay.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent enough, the hostel facilities are good, but the food is okay-ish. The college has good Wi-Fi and water facilities. The classrooms are large enough, and the library is the best place in the entire campus; it is like a treasure for design students. The quality of food in the hostel mess fluctuates very frequently; else, it is fine.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life but don't keep any fancy expectations, you'll be disappointed. Be open to learning.
reviews.review_text: Girls hostel is very good, food is not the best but better than most hostels, college infrastructure is also very good. In both places, whatever complaints are made, they're taking action upon immediately. The resource centre aka library is very good and filled with super expensive and rare books, make use of it.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement but the campus is small.
reviews.review_text: The campus area is limited due to its location in Mumbai, but overall, the facilities are impressive. The library boasts an extensive collection, and students have access to WGSN and Promostyl. Each room has separate Wi-Fi, although the speed could be improved. Labs are equipped to meet all requirements for garment construction.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bachelors in fashion technology from the NIFT Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: The college had good infrastructure and facilities for our course. In our course department, all the necessary facilities were available for the students. Various modern facilities for drafting and designing were available at the college. Sports, Wi-Fi, library and all other facilities were available for the better learning of the students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Fashion Technology, Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides good facilities. Our college has Wi-Fi-equipped classrooms, well-equipped labs, and an extensive resource center. The hostel facilities are good. The food served in the hostel is good. Medical facilities are available in the hostel. The hostel has a recreation room, a court, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Fashion Technology.
reviews.review_text: Course is very good with facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. Lab coordinators are very good and helpful. Hostel for girls is very good and for boys is above average. Canteen food is very good, takes proper care of hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the placements but dissatisfied with the salary packages offered.
reviews.review_text: NIFT Mumbai has one of the best campuses among all the NIFTs. Every classroom has air-conditioners. The campus has Wi-Fi as well. Due to covid, college is not providing hostel and canteen facilities. You will find creativity in everything. It also has a basketball and badminton (outdoor) court.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the course, college and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: NIFT Mumbai campus has everything. Our college provides facilities like the best resource centre, Wi-Fi connection and new building have a centralised air-conditioner. The hostel facility is well-maintained, and the quality of the food served is excellent. Our college provides labs in our course like pattern making lab and garment construction lab. A testing lab is also available in other departments that we can use by taking permission. Different kind of machines is available here, which we use...

reviews.review_heading: It is not worth a course, because at last you will get the knowledge, but you will not get the job.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. You will get every facility on the campus. The hostel can accommodate about 450 students. The hostel has facilities like a TV room, library, study area, playing area, beauty parlour and gym. Quality of the food in the hostel is average, but the hostel fee is too high, according to the facility they provide you.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best fashion institute in India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is fairly lavish from the benchmarks of an administration foundation. You will be truly stunned by the etiquette and tidiness kept up in the grounds. Aside from that, we truly know how to party, be it any event, any social affair it can never go squandered.

reviews.review_heading: It was not at all good enough because of its placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is nice. Washrooms are very clean. Classrooms are well maintained. Moreover, the canteen also offers a variety of things which you can order and eat, but the quality of food served is obviously not that good as compared to the outside food stores. You can have fast food and a proper main course for having a good meal there.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for real fashion world experience.
reviews.review_text: All types of facilities are available on our campus. As it's India's one of the top fashion college, we get exposure to the real fashion world. We have plenty of good lecturers and assistants, who are always available for students. Hostels are located nearby the college to save the time of students so that they can participate in other curricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: 1460 strenuous yet totally worth it days of a so called 'adult'. .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good because the college provides us with a lot of labs and classrooms that are well maintained with up to date gadgets. The college also provides the kids with a grand resources centre, it is like an ocean of books right from current day fashion to art history, you name it and they have it.

faqs.answer: A:    Greetings, NIFT is totally unaffected by the percentage you score in class 12. You just got to have a passing certificate.All that matters, is your CMR that you’ll score in the entrance exam.Everything coming up your way, from your choices of the centres, your second counselling advantage, to your SPT, will more or less depend on your CMR.So, you need to score well in your entrance exam and stop worrying about your percentage in class 12 But you must have passed the 10+2 level examination or equivalent examination from a recognised Board of Secondary Education in India with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as compulsory subjects.Thank you.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Textile Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Short review of NIFT Hyderabad.

content.Placements: The average package of the institute is 3 to 6 LPA, and the highest package as of now is 18 LPA. Students also get internships. Companies that come for placements include Raymond, Siyaram, and Aditya Birla. Along with opportunities from alumni and graduate students.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is very poor and small. Wi-Fi quality could be better. There is only a girls’ hostel, no boys’ hostel. The hostel food is okay and hygienic, but the toilets are in very poor condition. The course is good and includes many extracurricular activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied with this college.

content.Placements: Students have to register to take part in placement drives which use a centralised placement method. Companies visit our college to provide pre-placement offers or on-campus placement drives. Around 80% of students were placed in 2021. The highest salary package offered is 6 LPA. Around 80% to 90% of students get job offers in our college. Internships are provided in our college.
content.Infrastructure: Labs and studios are well-equipped. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. There is an auditorium with 350 seats, a spacious resource center, a college counsellor, a stationary, a gym, a cafeteria, and indoor and outdoor sports facilities. Canteen and mess serve 4 times delicious meals including breakfast, lunch, tea, and dinner.

individual_reviews.course: B.F.Tech. in Apparel Production (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is a good college with good faculty, but hostels could get a little better.

content.Placements: Out of all the courses that we have, maximum placements are obtained by students studying in the Fashion Communication and Fashion Technology department. They are placed in brands like Arvind Mills, Aditya Birla Group, Louis Philippe, etc. Students get better internships outside.
content.Infrastructure: There are better hostels on other main campuses like Gandhinagar, Bangalore, and Delhi. The Hyderabad campus is also good. It's the third-largest campus of all. The mess facilities have been getting better over a period of time. Sports are also taken care of.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The college has really good infrastructure, faculty, and average placements.

content.Placements: Our college offers campus placements, and students also get PPO. Students doing graduation programmes get pre-placement offers as well. The campus offers placements for the positions of associate designer for B.Des students and production managers for B.FTech students.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is really good and spacious. We are provided with lots of activities and facilities, such as pool tables, table tennis, volleyball, basketball, etc. Our college has a good dance team for all the dance enthusiasts. The cultural team organises a lot of events and trips throughout the year for the students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Knitwear Design - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty, many amenities, well maintained hostels, classes and labs .

content.Placements: This years pass outs are currently working hard on their internships and last year projects. Some of them have already received the placements while some are still looking for them. In my batch, as far as I know, two people have received their placements from 60,000 - 120000 / month.
content.Infrastructure: The classes are well built and air conditioned. There are a few amenities for students to pass time during their break, for instance a pool table and a TT table. The labs are well maintained and have everything you could possibly need for assignments. The hostels are well maintained and are in a twin-sharing system. The Hyderabad campus also provides a guest house facility for parents to stay in when they drop their children to college. The cost for that is 900 rs per night. The washrooms can use more maintenance, but they're relatively better than most campuses.

The use of facilities is very weak and the teams are not well versed and up-to-date. They charge extra to give you the degree, even after having paid a hefty fee.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A college that has a great amount of talent and creativity .

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed is between 60 and 70 percent. The highest package goes up to INR 600000 per year, and the lowest is around INR 200000 per year. The top recruiting companies are local business houses in Chennai itself. 80 percent of students got internships. The top roles offered in the course are associate designer, assistant designer, and fashion stylist.
content.Infrastructure: The campus as such is great. The design itself is super cool, and the facilities provided are great, like air conditioning in all labs. The Wi-Fi is decently good, and the library is packed with great books. The hostel is one of its best parts. It is amazing, super clean, and the food provided is not up to the mark, but it is still manageable, and it is really safe too; there is a nurse available 24/7. We also have a basketball court, a football field, a gym, and an indoor badminton court.

individual_reviews.course: B.FTech. in Apparel Production - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with our college.

content.Placements: Around 3 seniors from our college got placement for 25 LPA recently. That means B.FTech specifically has good placements at NIFT. Some of the other department seniors got placed at good companies in Noida and Delhi. Internships in our college are also great, and they are according to your grades and skills. Try gaining extra skills too.
content.Infrastructure: I love our hostel, it's perfectly maintained and has great food with transportation as well. The staff are caring and the wardens are also very responsible. The campus is also very well maintained, and everything is very aesthetic. You can look at your college from a different angle every day.

paragraphs: Students must appear for the NIFT entrance exam to get a seat in the desired programme. The admission process involves application form, entrance test, result declaration, counselling and seat allotment. Interested students can follow the step-by-stepadmission processexplained below:
Application Process
Students who fulfil the course-specific eligibility criteria can fill the application form through theofficial website.
Appear for the Entrance Exam

The students have to appear for the NIFT Entrance Exam. This entrance test is conducted in two parts: written exams and situation tests/ personal interviews. Moreover, the written exam is conducted in online mode. The situation test is in offline mode. The personal interview is in online mode.
Release of Cutoff List
After the selection rounds, the institute releases the cutoff list. TheNIFT Chennai cutoffmarks vary from one course to another.
NIFT Counselling

Students with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks become eligible for counselling. During counselling, a seat allotment procedure is carried out. The complete schedule is available on the official website.
Document Verification & Payment ofFees
After seat allotment, students have to submit the important documents at the institute. Along with this, students are asked to pay some amount of fees for seat confirmation.
Download NIFT Chennai Brochure

NIFT Patna offers degree and certificate programmes at the undergraduate (UG) and post-graduate (PG) level. The institute offers courses across Design, Technology and Management streams. UG courses offered byNIFT Patnainclude BDes in Fashion Design, Accessory Design, Textile Design and Fashion Communication. On the other hand, the design school offers only one PG course which is the Master of Fashion Management (MFM). It also offers Continuing Education (CE) programmes in Fashion and Clothing Technology which is of one-year duration.

NIFT Patna admission process for UG and PG courses starts in May every year. Candidates can apply for admission to the course of their choice in online mode. Candidates planning to pursue BDes are required to appear for CAT and GAT exams followed by the Situation Test. A valid score in the GAT exam is required for admission to BFTech. Students are selected for the MFM programme based on their performance in the GAT exam followed by the GD and PI round conducted by the institute. faqs.answer: Employment in NIFT Gandhinagar's Bachelor of Design (B.Des) programme varies somewhat. However, there are indications that employment has not been very good in the last couple of years due to market conditions. Top companies like Tanishq, Lifestyle, Naukri.com, Godrej, Nike, Spyker, Shopper Stop, and H&M are hiring in NIFT Gandhinagar. faqs.question: Does NIFT Gandhinagar offer better placements than National Institute of Fashion Technology, Chennai?
faqs.answer: NIFT Gandhinagar's placement percentage is lower than that of NIFT Chennai. However, NIFT Gandhinagar has made notable progress in recent years, and the difference has shrunk. High placement rates frequently above 90% are a feature of both educational institutions. In 2023, the most expensive package offered by NIFT Gandhinagar was about 12 LPA, while the most expensive package offered at NIFT Chennai was almost 22 LPA. Across various NIFT programmes, such as Fashion Design, Textile Design, Knitwear Design, etc., placement rates could vary significantly. Analyse information for your particular programme of interest. hostel.description: National Institute of Fashion Technology, Gandhinagar provides hotel facility only for girl students (preferably for first-year students). Facilities like Wi-Fi connectivity, water purifiers, mess, reading rooms, gym, TV, indoor and outdoor games, medical facility etc are provided. The hostel has two big common rooms for indoor sports, gymnasium, Yoga, TV, etc.

library.description:
National Institute of Fashion Technology, Gandhinagar has a resource center which consists of the Library Wing and Material Wing. The library consists books on garments, fashion, and technology and also subscribes to fashion journals and fashion forecast. Library also provides fashion periodical Index, bibliographies, subject/ picture files,  videotapes, slides, and CD-ROM. 
The material wing consists of Textiles, Costumes, Finding, and Accessories. The textile collection contains a fully documented collection of woven and printed patterns created for apparel & home furnishings, costume collection consists of well-known designer's clothing and regional costumes of India. Functional materials such as zippers, elastic, buttons, embellishments interfacing, linings and other materials needed to complete the garments are to be found in the findings collection. A variety of belts, bags, costume jewelry, yarn craft etc. is to be found in Accessories section.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good faculty. The campus is also the best.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. The campus is very big and nice. There are huge classrooms and labs. Over-timings of labs are scheduled for students. The hostel has good facilities. The mess provides good food. Good rooms are there in the hostel with good security.

reviews.review_heading: NIFT Gandhinagar overview.
reviews.review_text: We are provided with Wi-Fi, IT labs, PM labs, and sewing labs. The classrooms are well-equipped with AC and smart boards. The hostel is available only for first-year female students, and you can have food from the mess, but they charge for that. You’ll have to pay for one semester. The food is average, and medical facilities are available for students. Sports activities are also offered.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Fashion Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is satisfactory but the buildings need some renovation. Hostel rooms are good with double occupancy including two beds with no mattresses, tables, racks, and mirrored almirahs. There is an extra space above the almirahs for storing additional items.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, with decent future prospects.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are available. It is a bit small campus, compared to other new campuses. Hostel facility is available only for girls of first year. Food is good here. Doctors are available. Sports facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Fashion Technology, Gandhinagar.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides Wi-Fi facility, a library, and a canteen. Mess facility is available in our college. Our college provides good facilities. The hostel facilities are good. They provide 2 beds, 2 wardrobes, 2 tables, and 2 chairs in each room. They provide washing machine service, with a common room, and an induction stove.

reviews.review_heading: Theory based curriculum; good for people who want to go for research.
reviews.review_text: The master of design is a fairly new course. Classrooms have ACs, projectors and Wi-Fi. The hostel is decent, however there are no AC or cooler in the hostel. There is also strict curfew timings. The college campus is very small, and there is no proper ground for sports. We only have one basketball, and badminton court.

reviews.review_heading: It is average compared to other government design colleges, but far superior than the private ones.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is average with good architecture but not maintained. The hostel is available only for girls. The campus is big enough and has enough capacity to host good events. The only place the college lacks is the hostel facilities and there is always a rush to the mess.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good faculty members, but low exposure and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: It has a low infrastructure and a good library. The mess is poor. We have an average hostel and its capacity is low. There are air-conditioned classrooms. reviews.review_heading: There is a diverse college crowd on our campus.

There is a basketball, volleyball and badminton court on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is a hub of talented and accepting students.
reviews.review_text: It provides everything related to our course available in this college. Our library is diverse and there are a lot of books regarding our course available. The food served...

reviews.review_heading: NIFT GANDHINAGAR- college of fashion, tech, culture and craft.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility is for girls is available but only for 1 st year of college. 2nd year onwards you have to search for accommodation outside the campus. Sport and cultural activities takes place pretty often. NIFT GANDHINAGAR's janmashtam's and Garba fest is really happening.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good campus, and activities are also good.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides air-conditioned classrooms, conference halls, Wi-Fi, smart TV and resource centre. The infrastructure of our college is average, but it is bearable. The weather is very harsh during the summer. I don't know about the hostel as I am a day scholar.

reviews.review_heading: It is a nice place to discover yourself.
reviews.review_text: The college has very basic infrastructure, and we have equipment's that are as old as 10 years. Labs did not have air-conditioned facility till last year, the library seems a little insufficient and not so updated, Wi-Fi is available in the college but does not have a nice speed.

For each department, they have proper labs like for fashion design department. They have a sewing lab, for the text...

Students of different disciplines are accommodated in different floors of the building so that the other classes do not get disturbed.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des in Accessory Design - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: College is decent. You can go for it if you are really passionate about designing.

content.Placements: Accessory Design is doing quite well than other departments, especially for Jewellery Design people. The placements are also going decent. A lot of brands come for college placements as well. We have got labs too. The lab assistants are very good and helpful as well.
content.Infrastructure: Not so good, hostels are ***. The food is bad, the facilities are poor, you have to share rooms and you only get hostels in the first year, after that it's all luck-based. The infrastructure is also very average, I won't recommend it at all. If you have other options, don't opt for it.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Knitwear Design - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Not satisfied with placement as the college charges hefty fee.

content.Placements: Placements are good for some departments and bad for others. FC and F&LA get nice placements while the other 5 departments suffer with either low-paying jobs or even no jobs at times. So, depends on the course you choose. Earlier it was quite good, but it's regrading.
content.Infrastructure: Only a girl's hostel is available and the college is too small. Small playground and library. Overall the college is very small. The labs are enough with all the resources required like knitting machines, overlock machines and of course SNLS machines.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des in Accessory Design - Batch of 2027

faqs.question: Is National Institute of Fashion Technology Kolkata hard to get?

paragraphs: NIFT Kolkata admissionis based onentrance exams. Candidates meeting course-specific eligibility can take the NIFT entrance exam to get a seat in the desired programme. The admission process starts with online registration followed by entrance test, result declaration, counselling and seat allotment. Interested students can follow theNIFT Kolkata admission processas given below:
Application Process
Those who fulfil the eligibility can fill out the application form. Eligible students can fill out the application form through the NIFT website atnift.ac.in/niftadmissions.in/nift.ac.in/admission.
Entrance Exam

Students have to appear for the NIFT Entrance Exam which is conducted in two parts: written exams and situation tests/personal interviews. Moreover, the written exam is conducted in online mode. The situation test is in offline mode, and thepersonal interviewis in online mode. The exam includes General Ability Test (GAT) and Creative Ability Test (CAT).
Release of Cutoff List
After the selection rounds, the institute releases theNIFT Kolkata cutoff list. The cutoff marks vary from one course to another.
NIFT Counselling

Candidates with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks become eligible for counselling. During counselling, a seat allotment procedure is carried out. The complete schedule regarding the same shall be available on the NIFT official website.
Document Verification & Payment of NIFT KolkataFees
After seat allotment, candidates may have to submit the important documents at the institute. Along with this, candidates are asked to pay some amount of fees as well for seat confirmation.
NIFT Kolkata Fee & Seats 2026

NIFT Kolkata's total tuition feecan be paid annually or semester-wise. However, a few components are paid only once, such as the one-time fee. The students must pay the fee for the desired course at the time of admission.NIFT Kolkata feesdiffer according to the course and specialisation selected by the applicants. reviews_list.review_title: I am not satisfied with the mess food of our college.

review_content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi facility is not good on campus. In some places, Wi-Fi works, at some places, it doesn't work. Classrooms are air-conditioned. The library is good. Hostels are not in a good condition. Only one refrigerator is available for the entire hostel on the ground floor. We have washing machines and a microwave. Mess food is not good. Every time, there is a crowd during lunchtime. The canteen food is quite fine.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers in our college are helpful, qualified, supportive, and knowledgeable. They always encourage students. The curriculum is well-planned and executed. You can give time to explore many things yourself. We don't have semester exams, instead, there are juries who prepare you for the industry. In the 1st year, we had four batches. The course is the same for all 1st-year students. It includes the fundamentals for our upcoming semesters. In 2nd year, you get into your department, study, and explore all about that field of your interest.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Des. in Textile Design - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: The institute makes us creative and it boosts our self esteem.

review_content.Placements: Average placement this year was around 4-5 LPA as NIFT gives 100% placements. It all depends on your portfolio, better portfolio means better placement. Companies such as Arvind Mill, Peter England, Lifestyle, Ikea, Flipkart, Tarun Tehlani and many more come for placements. While pursuing textile you can get jobs such as textile designer, fashion forecaster, stylist, fashion designer, screen printing designers, surface designer, home and space expert, fashion expert and many more.
review_content.Infrastructure: NIFT Jodhpur is a residential campus. One of the largest campuses of NIFT. AC rooms, huge library, Wi-Fi, labs with ample amount of equipments, stationary, canteens, general store, gardens, open theatre, sports area, medical rooms, etc. are available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Des. in Fashion Communication - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: The infrastructure is well maintained. Hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls.

review_content.Placements: Every student is assigned a mentor to help him/her out in approaching industries and provide them with internships and placements. They happen only in four or five campuses of NIFT like Delhi, Mumbai, and Bangalore. More than 90% of the students have been placed at an average package of 3.6 LPA whereas the internship takes place in Daman, Bangalore, Delhi, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: AC hostels are available for girls. Boys hostels don't have AC, and they only have coolers. From this year, they are even going to provide boys hostel only till the second year. The canteen has okay food, the menu could have been larger. Hostel rooms are simple, with nothing fancy about them.

individual_reviews.title: Best faculty, good placements, amazing infrastructure and one of the best design colleges in India.

content.Placements: Our placement results were significantly better than anticipated with more than 80% placement rate & an average pay of 3-4.5LPA. The students were employed by a variety of export businesses, design studios, design houses and startups. Some have even started their own brands.
content.Infrastructure: With the largest & totally residential campus of any NIFT center, this college boasts the best infrastructure. Sports, indoor gaming, & round-the-clock Wi-Fi are just a few of our many attractions. The classrooms & textile labs are also well-equipped.

admission_overview.college_name: NIFT Jodhpur Course Admissions 2025: Fees, Eligibility, Dates & Selection Process

paragraphs: National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT), Jodhpur admissions are completely entrance-based. The university offers degree and certificate programmes at the undergraduate (UG) and post-graduate (PG) levels in the stream of Design and Technology. Candidates can fill an online application form to get admission to BDes, BFTech and MFM atNIFT Jodhpur.

Candidates can apply for admission to the course of their choice in online mode. NIFT Johdpur admission to UG and PG courses is based on marks scored inNIFT Entrance Exam. NIFT Entrance Exam is divided into three parts i.e.Creative Ability Test (CAT), General Ability Test (GAT) and Situation Test/ Group Discussion and Personal Interview (GD and PI) round. Candidates planning to pursue BDes, BFTech and MFM course must appear for all the selection rounds.

NIFT Jodhpur includes BDes in Fashion Design, Accessory Design, Textile Design and Fashion Communication and BFTech. On the other hand, the design school offers only one PG course which is the Master of Fashion Management (MFM). NIFT Jodhpur also offers Continuing Education (CE)/ Diploma programmes which is of one year duration each. Candidates need to meet the basic eligibility requirements of the programmes they wish to apply for.The following table gives a quick snapshot of all the courses and their eligibility criteria related to NIFT Jodhpur course admission 2025:

NIFT Jodhpur feeis a sum of various components such as tuition fee, caution deposit, exam fee, etc. Some of the fee components like caution deposit are one-time paid while tuition fee is paid annually. Moreover, NIFT Jodhpur seat intake varies course-wise. Candidates are offered seats based on their merit. Once the seat is allotted, candidates are required to pay the course fee to confirm their admission. Check the following table for more course-wise statistics:

The admission process for NIFT Jodhpur 2025 consists of three simple steps that are detailed below in a step-by-step manner:
STEP 1: NIFT Jodhpur Application Process 2025

NIFT Jodhpur application process is carried out in online mode. Candidates need to meet the basic eligibility requirements and fill out the application form through the NIFT official website (nift.ac.in/niftadmissions.in/nift.ac.in/admission). Check here the detailedsteps of application for NIFT entrance exam.
STEP 2: Appear for the Entrance Exam

After the submission of application form, candidates need to the applicant has to appear for theNIFT Entrance Exam. This entrance test is conducted in two parts: written exams and situation tests/personal interviews. Moreover, the written exam is conducted in online mode. The situation test is in offline mode and the personal interview is in online mode. This is a mandatory step for admission to any of the courses offered at NIFT Jodhpur/
STEP 3: Release of Cutoff List
After the selection rounds, the institute releases thecutoff list. The cutoff marks vary from one course to another.
STEP 4: NIFT Counselling

Candidates with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks become eligible for counselling. During counselling, a seat allotment procedure is carried out. The complete schedule regarding the same shall be available on the NIFT official website.
STEP 5: Document Verification & Payment of NIFT Jodhpur Fees
After seat allotment, candidates may have to submit the important documents at the institute. Alongside, candidates must also pay a certain amount of fee to lock their seats.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Fashion Technology, Jodhpur.

The college provides all types of sports facilities and also medical facilities for emergency and every disease. The quality of the food served in the canteen is average as compared to other colleges. However, overall the campus and infrastructure are good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is superb, and it provides time to pursue your hobbies.

The campus has all the facilities as well as the open space required to make it feel like home. Hostels are well constructed and are spacious enough for students.

reviews.review_heading: We are provided with the best infrastructure and other facilities.

Hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls. There are an auditorium, canteen, mess, and open-air theatre. The campus is huge enough to conduct any sort of events.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Fashion Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. All labs are available, and classrooms are good with projectors and A/C facilities. Sound systems are also installed in classrooms. There is 24x7 Wi-Fi facility available in campus and hostels. A lot of games like volleyball, kho-kho, basketball, badminton, chess, and football are conducted here, and there are coaches available for the betterment of students who are interested in sports.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Fashion Technology.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi provided has sufficient speed but has some restrictions like blocked P2P. Labs, classrooms and library are still under expansion. The medical facilities are provided by the Ayurveda which is situated just opposite to the Institute. The canteen has okayish food, the menu could have been larger. Hostel rooms are simple, nothing fancy about them. They provide you with the basic needs.

fees_and_eligibility.overview:
NIFT Kannur offers BDes and BFTech at UG level and MDes and MFM at PG level. The duration of UG programmes - BDes and BFTech offered by NIFT Kannur is four years. For PG programme - MFM and MDes the duration is two years. Apart from UG and PG programmes, it also offers five Continuing Education Programmes (CEPs) with a duration ranging from 24 days to 4 months. The seat intake for BDes is 44 each for Fashion Design, Knitwear Design, Textile Design and Fashion Communication. The seat intake for BFTech, MFM and MDes is 45 each.

faqs.answer: A:    NIFT is a national-level design entrance exam conducted by the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT). The exam is conducted once every year and it consist of two parts, i.e, first one is, written exam and second is, situation test/personal interview.Written Exams - It comprise the GAT and CAT. The GAT paper is mandatory for all programs, while only BDes and MDes candidates need to take the CAT. Situation Test/ Personal Interview - BDes candidates who get shortlisted have to appear in the Situation Test, whereas PG candidates need to appear in a Personal Interview. The only exception is BFTech program, where the admission merit list will be prepared solely based on GAT scores.    The FINAL score of NIFT 2024 for the other programs will be prepared by giving weightage to the written exams and Situation Test/ Personal Interview.The scores or merit rank of NIFT will be considered for admission to design courses offered by the NIFT participating institutes. Currently, there are 18 participating institutes that offer the following courses - BDes, MDes, BFTech, MFTech, and MFM courses.

review_summary.college_name: NIFT Kannur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Design (M.Des.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the best college for the M.Des. course.

content.Placements: Almost 66% of students improved during our study. The highest wage offered was 17 LPA, and the lowest was 2 LPA. The average wage was between 7 and 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course included Arvind Garments, Tommy Hilfiger, and Fab India. Industry training resulted in internships for nearly 60% of the students. Top positions included content graphic designer, fashion designer, and more.
content.Infrastructure: The campus had 15 hostels for both boys and girls. Tarachand was the best-known hostel at the university. The university also offered exclusive hostel rooms to international students. Hostel quality was superb, but politics were prevalent. Food and sports facilities were good.

individual_reviews.course: B.FTech. in Apparel Production - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: What You Didn't Know About the National Institute of Fashion Technology.

content.Placements: About 90% of the students get placed in different sectors of the fashion industry. The highest package is 80 LPA and the lowest is 7 LPA for B.FTech. Top recruiters are Puma, Myntra, Reliance, Raymond, etc. About 100% of students do their internships in companies such as Vardhman Textile, Levis, Raymond, etc. The top roles are HR Manager, Buyer, Production Manager, Production Controller, Senior Executive, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped with top-of-the-line machines required for apparel production. Only the girls' hostel is available here in Kannur, and it is well-occupied with everything you need. It has all varieties of Indian foods from different parts of India and top-of-the-line facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B. Des. in Textile Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Life at Nift Kannur be like.

content.Placements: I have not completed the course yet. I have heard from seniors and alumni that the placements are above average. If you work hard, get good grades, and prepare well, you will get good placements. The college faculty also said the same during orientation: it depends on you.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is good but could be better. The college is working on it, so hopefully it will be better next year. The auditorium and hostel rooms could be better (they are working on it), but the classrooms and other facilities are good. Most probably, everything will be nice next year.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Knitwear Design - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This is the best campus ever.

content.Placements: NIFT is providing good placements; in the past, they have also provided good placements. At Nift Kannur, we will get placements, but not for every student, and we will get a chance to work with a designer. In Nift Kannur, you can explore the companies and the job offers they are making.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus has a huge setup of Wi-Fi, and the campus also has the best facilities, but boys don't have hostels. The classes and campus are neat and clean, and the resource center has a collection of books. And the infrastructural structure of the campus is very nice; it's unique compared to the other campuses.

individual_reviews.course: B.FTech. in Apparel Production - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with placements and campus life.

content.Placements: There is around 60% to 70% placement this year. The highest package this year was around 9 LPA. Top recruiters are Trident, Raymond, and Arvind. About 100% of students get internship opportunities in Arvind, Raymond, and Laguna. About70% to 80% of students get internships in different apparel companies. Top roles offered are merchandiser, production manager, IE executive, etc.
content.Infrastructure: It has Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, a garment construction room, and a pattern-making lab. The hostel is enough for girls. There is no hostel for boys, but there are PGs outside the campus. The hostel provides good quality food. Medical facilities are available with games like basketball, snooker, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Everyday is a new interesting fun day.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is provided both in the hostel and college. The college has separate labs and classrooms for each specialisations. The college also has a resource center or a library with interesting and knowledgeable books which makes it a favourite place for a lot of students. The food quality in the mess or canteen is average. It does have medical facilities and therapists available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: The  college has really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is exquisite and in pristine condition. Although the campus is very small, the location is easily reachable, and there are several places like the nearby market, shops, local foods, entertainment places, hotels etc.

reviews.review_heading: Fashion management is an art, and we can learn that here.
reviews.review_text: Currently, it's a mediocre campus, but soon the campus will be shifted to another place which is quite big. Books in the library are updated every month, and the computer labs are in good condition. High-speed Wi-Fi facility is available in the college as well as in the hostel. Medical facilities are available whenever needed.

reviews.review_heading: Really appreciable infrastructure with great scope for future designers with creative minds.
reviews.review_text: We have good infrastructural facilities with proper IT labs for each department and workshops with proper functioning machineries. Recource centres with newer trend forecast are available I. e, promostyl and WGSN. Students are given an exposure to companies for internships and graduation projects in well renouned fashion industries.

reviews.review_heading: College life in Shillong.
reviews.review_text: I am not a hosteler but I know a little bit so it's okay. Labs are good. We have different types of labs, computer lab, leather lab, wood lab, and every department has its own labs. Wi-Fi is good. We have a canteen also and a shop for stationery.

placements.overview:
Pearl Academy, Jaipur (formerly Pearl Academy of Fashion) is one of the leading institutions offering education in the stream of Design, Fashion, and Media. It was established in 2005 and was set up by the Creative Arts Education Society. It is one of the five campuses based in Delhi West, Delhi South, Mumbai and Bengaluru that come under the Pearl Academy. The campus has been offered provisional affiliation from Rajasthan ILD Skill University (a UGC-recognised University) and offers degree programmes following the International Standards at UG and PG levels in the fields of Design, Fashion and Media.

Pearl Academy, Jaipur is not a degree-granting institution, but it facilitates the enrolment of students for Indian and International Bachelor’s degrees from recognised institutions. Further, it maintains academic and strategic collaborations with various organisations including the Fashion Design Council of India, the Gems & Jewellery Skill Council of India, the National Skill Development Corporation and the Institute of Indian Interior Designers.

The flagship programmes at Pearl Academy Jaipur include BDes and MDes. Apart from this, the institute also offers UG and PG Diploma courses in Design and Fashion, including Graphic Design, Jewellery Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design, and Craft and design. It also offers PG courses specifically designed for working professionals. The institute also extends several professional Certificate courses.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides excellent placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available throughout the campus. Air-conditioners and projectors were available in classrooms. Stitching labs, textile labs, etc., were available. Classrooms were spacious and well-equipped. The hostel facilities were good.

reviews.review_heading: I did Post Graduation course, journey was amazing overall. I definitely recommend it.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure wise nothing can beat Pearl Academy, Jaipur. The college provides Wi-Fi, classrooms, a library where you can log in to fashion websites free of cost, and access to stitching, dyeing, etc. Labs at any time of the day or call it any day. Nothing can beat the quality of services they provide.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent platform for fashion students to enrich their knowledge.
reviews.review_text: Our Jaipur campus has the best infrastructure for the designing students among India, with completely equipped machines. Opportunities have been completely given to us to enrich the knowledge of fashion throughout the course and trained us throughout.

reviews.review_heading: Life changing opportunities with international exposure and excellent faculty members.
reviews.review_text:
Everything is to the point in case of facilities. The Hostels are really good and the mess too as my friends stay there and are very satisfied with the Hostel.
There is time to time upgradation in the facilities demanded by the students. There is full freedom of speech and the facilities provided are very satisfying and useful for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, inspiring faculty, but can work better for placements.
reviews.review_text: A medical room is, and good air-conditioning is available in the college. Labs and classrooms are neat and clean with proper air conditioners and projector screens. The Wi-Fi connection quality is not that good. Gaming and sports are good as there is a big playground on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is an average college.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is the best, but the facility is not that according to the amount of fee they are taking. It is comfortable and designed by keeping in mind, its purpose, and for whom it is designed. The campus has full of greenery as well.

reviews_list.review_title: Review of Amity School of Fashion Technology, Amity University, Noida.

review_content.Placements: No student got placed. There were no salary packages offered. Everyone should realize Amity University is the definition of everything wrong with universities. Faculty members are terrible. Students are even worst. They offered no opportunities in this course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was average. Facilities available are fine. The thing that differentiates Amity from other institutions is that after taking lakhs of rupees they still do not provide hand wash or soap on campus.
review_content.Faculty: Faculty members were not good. They get PhDs and sit in class and don't have the faintest idea of what they're doing or saying. They have no practical experience that cause conflicts between faculty and students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with faculty members.

review_content.Placements: Around 40% of students got selected from the first round of placements. The highest salary package offered was 9 LPA, and the average salary package offered in fashion design was 4 LPA. Top retail recruiting companies were Aditya Birla Group, Gas, Uniqlo, Globus, JMD Garments, etc. Around 60% of students got internships in brands such as Jack & Jones, Puma, and Shahi Exports. Major roles offered were fashion consultant, visual merchandiser, fashion designer, Retail manager, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus was spread over 70 acres of land. It had many buildings for different courses. The fashion design building was spacious with modern infrastructure and facilities where Wi-Fi connectivity was excellent and labs were spacious. All classrooms had a modern seating area. They had projectors. The hostel facility was good but more costly than the outer hostels. Our canteen provided a variety of food items to choose from and had major outlets such as subway and dominos. A doctor was always available for checkups and provided temporary medicines. Our college had a central library with modern infrastructure and all the facilities like online connectivity and an ample amount of books.

reviews_list.review_title: Our college is friendly and well mannered.

review_content.Placements: You will get skill-based placement as per your performance. You shouldn't only depend on the college and try individually also. The college will help you to get placements. You should participate in extracurricular activities for a better CV and have a good portfolio.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good. The hostel is a bit expensive and mess is not added to hostel fees. Labs are average. Computers are well worked. Wi-Fi connection is available in the whole block. Classrooms are well-planned and mannered. They have air-conditioners also. Overall, it's nice.

individual_reviews.course: M.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Pearl Academy, first batch of M.Des Fashion Design, ongoing semester 2.

content.Placements: I have not reached that stage yet, just started my second semester. But I have heard from my seniors that based on your merit, placements are as promised. Roles offered could be design intern, stylist, merchandiser, textile designer, etc. 20.27 LPA is the highest offered package.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is great. Everything is as shown during the campus tour. I did not opt for the hostel, so I don't know about that. There isn't a textile lab, but there are three computer labs, one of which has all MAC computers. There is consistent Wi-Fi for students. The library is accessible and has a good collection. Classrooms are decent. The campus is continuously air-conditioned.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des in Fashion Design - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The honest & unbiased review on Pearl Academy.

content.Placements: The college is in Mumbai it is the biggest advantage for many fashion brands and big fashion events and most importantly, Bollywood is located in Mumbai. College has a lot of contacts with designers and fashion brands, but firstly, we need to work under well-known fashion designers Masaba Gupta, Rutu Bosle, Anita Dongre, and Agarwal for at least 2 months. But I feel regret after doing this degree, spending 20 lacs on it, and now getting a job with a 2-3 lacs package. If you are placed in a good package, within the month you get laid off because they don't have money to pay you. NIFT is much better in terms of placement.

individual_reviews.course: M.Des in Communication Design - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: PGCD from peral academy at a fingertip.

content.Placements: The placement percentage of the students on campus for this particular course is 90% and the students get placed in a not so good company but the average salary is less than the industry standard as it is 7,20,000 rupees for every year only and the companies are McKinsey & Company.
content.Infrastructure: When I talk about the facilities and the infrastructure it is almost at par with other big colleges in the country, this college has not had that many fancy things and neither anything less from them but yes the one thing that our college takes care of is food, The food served is best in quality.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des in Fashion Design - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Our college's faculty members are very supportive of students.

content.Placements: The placement committee at our college is a dedicated team, and they provide placements to all the students, depending on different skill sets. Many top fashion design firms visit here like Myntra, Fab India, H&M, Zara and many others. They have more than a 95% of track record in placements, and I am eager to get the opportunities they offer in my final year.
content.Infrastructure: Labs and classrooms are spacious and give comfortable spaces for students to do their work. The Wi-Fi is on every floor and has decent connectivity overall, with set limitations for certain websites. It is more than enough for college work. The canteen is on the ground floor and has a huge selection of different varieties of food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des in Fashion Communication - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college gives great industry exposure to the students.

content.Placements: In placements, we have companies like NDTV, Dharma, Shopper Stop, Scoopwhoop, etc. Many top placements are happening in these high-profile companies, and top students get to work for them. Internships are offered in these top media firms for third-year students as well.
content.Infrastructure: Our college's Wi-Fi system is comprehensive and has availability on every floor. There are two photography labs for students to use, along with many media labs and computer labs with Macintosh systems. The e-library and physical library have all the books and resources which students need.

admission_overview.title: Pearl Academy Mumbai Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: Pearl Academy Mumbai admission are offered mainly through entrance exam scores. Students need to appear either for exam conducted by the academy for selection. The academy offers BDes, MDes, BBA, MBA, and Professional Certificate courses. These are provided in the fields of Design, Fashion, Communication, and Media. The application process for the college commences online. Admission to the courses offered at Pearl Academy Mumbai are based on scores of the Pearl Academy Entrance Exam or PAF Entrance Exam and Personal Interview (PI). The Pearl Academy Entrance Exam consists of GPT (General Proficiency Test) and DAT (Design Aptitude Test). At Pearl Academy Mumbai, students are also offered short-term professional courses in various streams. A total of 45 courses are offered at Pearl Academy, Mumbai.

While for the PG admissions, graduation marks are required. Students are selected based on the in-house entrance test which includes both Written Test and Personal Interview. Both can be taken from your computer itself.

Pearl Academy Mumbai Application Process 2026

Students are required to fill in the application form and submit the same to the college. The applications are accepted through both online and offline modes. Along with the application, the applicants can submit several supporting documents and the application fee.
Shortlisting of Students

After registration, candidates need to take the Pearl Entrance Exam. ThePearl Academy Exam Resultsare published on the Pearl Academy official website. The institute also emails individual scorecards to the students.
Personal Interview & Portfolio Screening

For admission to the design courses, students may have to present their portfolios to the panel. The college conducts an entrance exam which includes written test and personal interview. Students can pick their preferred time slot.
Payment of Admission Fee & Admission Confirmation
After the selection rounds, the selected students can further confirm their seats by paying the admission fee in part or full.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: I have pursued B.Com (Hons) from Amity University Lucknow; great campus, best college life.

review_content.Placements: The percent of students placed in this course is 90%. The highest package for this course was 4,50,000, and the lowest was 2,00,000. The top recruiting companies include Amazon, HCL, etc. 100% of students get internships from the course in HCL. Mostly, data analyst roles are available.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for the B.Com course include a library, classrooms, and Wi-Fi. The hostel quality was quite good, but it could be more well-structured, and the quality of food available in the mess was great in taste. Every weekend they have something special. Other than this, a canteen, medical store, and sports facilities were also available.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: BBA at Amity University, Lucknow: The best time of my life.

review_content.Placements: After BBA, placements are not that high that year. Around 35% of students got placed. The highest package for a graduation is 7.9 LPA. Companies like HDFC Bank, RBL Bank, and Mahindra Finance come to the campus. Sales executive roles are offered by recruiters. Also, the internship percentage is very high.
review_content.Infrastructure: At Amity University, you will always get top-class infrastructure available. Libraries, classes, labs, and even the corridors are so neat and clean, you always feel like being in the best college. The food in the mess is also served fresh and tasty. For every medical emergency, there is a van always available, and first aid is easily available. Every sport is played, like table tennis, lawn tennis, football, cricket, volleyball, basketball, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, the college is great. You can study and develop connections.

review_content.Placements: Around 50% students were placed, the highest package is 4.5 LPA, and it is in Quality Assurance. The top recruiting companies are Cipla, Alkem Laboratories, Pfizer, etc. Overall, the placement is average, but the placement cell tries its best to get every student placed in a good company with a good package.
review_content.Infrastructure: The Amity University Lucknow campus has impressive infrastructure that creates a perfect environment for learning and growing, the university provides both indoor and outdoor sports facilities. The playgrounds are well maintained, and the classrooms are great.

reviews_list.batch_info: LL.M in Criminal Law - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It is okay for a master's degree with no good placements. We get a good experience.

review_content.Placements: Self-placements are a better option here since few recruiters visit the college in this branch for placements, so we can head to Noida. It is a branch for better recruiters. Here we can get a good LL.M degree of value in no time, and with ease we can score well. All these help in future career prospects.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good, and it was recently renovated. The college has good classrooms and an AC campus. The only issue is drinking water, and the rest is nice. Around the campus, we can get access to anything, so it is a highlight. A brilliant central library is a key structure with a clock tower above it.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.A. in Counselling Psychology - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Honest review of my college.

review_content.Placements: Since I had to study further, as well as most of my batchmates wanted the same. Placement is not a factor in the course. Even though there are provisions for placement in many publishing houses and companies in post is content/creative writers with CTC around 2 LPA. As far as internships, we have a summer project, where we have to submit a detailed research paper. This paper is a subject as in whole and is taken very seriously. Weekly reports have to be represented on the progress, and each individual is assigned a mentor. There is no stipend.
review_content.Infrastructure: College can not provide a hostel I live in civil line Jabalpur. There are many hostels and the charge is Rs 4,000 approximately. Hostel condition is very good. The students live in a hostel and they enjoy their life.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.A. in Counselling Psychology - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: We have a heavy workload, and too much emphasis on attendance, but good networking and internships.

review_content.Placements: Placement opportunities are represented to students but not very thoroughly, at the end, a few get placed. Students got internships from local as well as prestigious companies like Counsel India. The top roles are trainee psychologists and HR roles in companies as well.
review_content.Infrastructure: The department is overall nice. The infrastructure and campus are quite good but need more maintenance. The library is an amazing place to be in, canteen and food services are okay. Overall it is good, still needs to improve a lot. There is ample ground space and opportunities to engage in sports and games.
