individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I have pursued B.Com (Hons) from Amity University Lucknow; great campus, best college life.

content.Placements: The percent of students placed in this course is 90%. The highest package for this course was 4,50,000, and the lowest was 2,00,000. The top recruiting companies include Amazon, HCL, etc. 100% of students get internships from the course in HCL. Mostly, data analyst roles are available.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for the B.Com course include a library, classrooms, and Wi-Fi. The hostel quality was quite good, but it could be more well-structured, and the quality of food available in the mess was great in taste. Every weekend they have something special. Other than this, a canteen, medical store, and sports facilities were also available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: BBA at Amity University, Lucknow: The best time of my life.

content.Placements: After BBA, placements are not that high that year. Around 35% of students got placed. The highest package for a graduation is 7.9 LPA. Companies like HDFC Bank, RBL Bank, and Mahindra Finance come to the campus. Sales executive roles are offered by recruiters. Also, the internship percentage is very high.
content.Infrastructure: At Amity University, you will always get top-class infrastructure available. Libraries, classes, labs, and even the corridors are so neat and clean, you always feel like being in the best college. The food in the mess is also served fresh and tasty. For every medical emergency, there is a van always available, and first aid is easily available. Every sport is played, like table tennis, lawn tennis, football, cricket, volleyball, basketball, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the college is great. You can study and develop connections.

content.Placements: Around 50% students were placed, the highest package is 4.5 LPA, and it is in Quality Assurance. The top recruiting companies are Cipla, Alkem Laboratories, Pfizer, etc. Overall, the placement is average, but the placement cell tries its best to get every student placed in a good company with a good package.
content.Infrastructure: The Amity University Lucknow campus has impressive infrastructure that creates a perfect environment for learning and growing, the university provides both indoor and outdoor sports facilities. The playgrounds are well maintained, and the classrooms are great.

individual_reviews.course: LL.M in Criminal Law - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is okay for a master's degree with no good placements. We get a good experience.

content.Placements: Self-placements are a better option here since few recruiters visit the college in this branch for placements, so we can head to Noida. It is a branch for better recruiters. Here we can get a good LL.M degree of value in no time, and with ease we can score well. All these help in future career prospects.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good, and it was recently renovated. The college has good classrooms and an AC campus. The only issue is drinking water, and the rest is nice. Around the campus, we can get access to anything, so it is a highlight. A brilliant central library is a key structure with a clock tower above it.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Counselling Psychology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Honest review of my college.

content.Placements: Since I had to study further, as well as most of my batchmates wanted the same. Placement is not a factor in the course. Even though there are provisions for placement in many publishing houses and companies in post is content/creative writers with CTC around 2 LPA. As far as internships, we have a summer project, where we have to submit a detailed research paper. This paper is a subject as in whole and is taken very seriously. Weekly reports have to be represented on the progress, and each individual is assigned a mentor. There is no stipend.
content.Infrastructure: College can not provide a hostel I live in civil line Jabalpur. There are many hostels and the charge is Rs 4,000 approximately. Hostel condition is very good. The students live in a hostel and they enjoy their life.

faqs.question: What is MBA fees at Amity University Lucknow?
faqs.answer: INR 10.4 lakh - INR 13.8 lakh is the total tuition fee range at Amity Lucknow for MBA course. Aspirants are required to pay the course fee after completion of all the selection rounds to confirm their seats. Admission to MBA course is based on national-level entrance exam CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, etc. The university also conducts AMCAT for providing admission to MBA course. Additionally, candidates need to qualify English test for admission to MBA International. The shortlisted candidates are further called for a personal interview round. In case, a candidate is unable to pay the fee within the specified time, his or her admission will stand cancelled. The application fee is waived off for admission at Amity Lucknow.

reviews.review_heading: I have pursued B.Com (Hons) from Amity University Lucknow; great campus, best college life.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for the B.Com course include a library, classrooms, and Wi-Fi. The hostel quality was quite good, but it could be more well-structured, and the quality of food available in the mess was great in taste. Every weekend they have something special. Other than this, a canteen, medical store, and sports facilities were also available.

reviews.review_heading: BBA at Amity University, Lucknow: The best time of my life.
reviews.review_text: At Amity University, you will always get top-class infrastructure available. Libraries, classes, labs, and even the corridors are so neat and clean, you always feel like being in the best college. The food in the mess is also served fresh and tasty. For every medical emergency, there is a van always available, and first aid is easily available. Every sport is played, like table tennis, lawn tennis, football, cricket, volleyball, basketball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is great. You can study and develop connections.
reviews.review_text: The Amity University Lucknow campus has impressive infrastructure that creates a perfect environment for learning and growing, the university provides both indoor and outdoor sports facilities. The playgrounds are well maintained, and the classrooms are great.

reviews.review_heading: It is okay for a master's degree with no good placements. We get a good experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, and it was recently renovated. The college has good classrooms and an AC campus. The only issue is drinking water, and the rest is nice. Around the campus, we can get access to anything, so it is a highlight. A brilliant central library is a key structure with a clock tower above it.

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: College can not provide a hostel I live in civil line Jabalpur. There are many hostels and the charge is Rs 4,000 approximately. Hostel condition is very good. The students live in a hostel and they enjoy their life.

reviews.review_heading: We have a heavy workload, and too much emphasis on attendance, but good networking and internships.
reviews.review_text: The department is overall nice. The infrastructure and campus are quite good but need more maintenance. The library is an amazing place to be in, canteen and food services are okay. Overall it is good, still needs to improve a lot. There is ample ground space and opportunities to engage in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is great.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and security are great. The hostel facility is good. The food is not that great. The campus has great Wi-Fi facilities all over the campus. The library is so beautiful with all the course books and extracurricular books as well. The quality of food in the mess is not at all good. Canteen food is better than mess food.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it provides the best and most reliable packages.
reviews.review_text: Libraries and hostel rooms are fantastic and clean. The service that is provided in the library and classrooms is very impressive, but sometimes Wi-Fi stops working, which is a manageable point. Medical facilities are also provided there for some small health issues. Ground is very big, so students can enjoy their recess and free time.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: In the hostel, bedsheet pillow and pillow cover were provided and table was provided. Meal quality was not so good but breakfast was really very good. We could complete the registration from the official website of Amity University Lucknow.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Amity University, Lucknow campus.
reviews.review_text: We have here Wi-Fi connections, computer labs, classrooms, and library. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is very good with good cleanliness, supportive wardens and staff. Rooms are also quite good and if we look for medical facilities here we have an infirmary in our hostel which has well-specialized doctors. And if we talk about sports and games here is very nice as we have a big backyard ground where we have basketball court, badminton court, cricket ground, and many indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University in Lucknow For M.Sc.  MB Course admission in 25-26.
reviews.review_text: This course's infrastructure quality is very good and uses high-quality materials and products. The college has classrooms, bathrooms, a library, a canteen, a hostel, etc. The canteen facilities are also good and there are many varieties of food available.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University in Uttar Pradesh, course and admission.
reviews.review_text: In this college, library facilities are available and there are all subject books present in the cell. Department classroom is very clean and the bathroom also. Wi-Fi for the whole time is provided and we also have water coolers, a canteen, the best sitting areas, and fully air-conditioned corridors and classes too.

Hostels are not at all good they are just overpriced and the mess food is not good.

review_content.Placements: 85% of students were placed in our course, average package offered in course was 5 LPA (approximately). individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Animation and Game Design - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A place to start your design journey.

content.Placements: I'm an animation game design student currently in my 2nd year; internships and placements are offered in my 3rd and 4th years. I have heard about companies like Rock Star, Ikarus 3D, Amazon Game Studios, etc. coming to our college and many more game development studios. Looking over the lucrative game industry In India, good jobs are hard to find and at the end of the day, it all depends on your portfolio. The college is trying their best to bring companies on campus but if one's portfolio isn't strong, he ain't going to get any jobs.
content.Infrastructure: World University has a campus size of approximately 12 acres, which is quite good for an only-design university. Specifically, for animation game design, we have pretty high-end labs with Rtx-enabled PCs and an x-pen tab for each student; even ARVR technology is provided. Talking about hostels, both boys and girls hostels have three sharing rooms equipped with air conditioning. Private washrooms are there in each room.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Animation and Game Design - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: The campus had good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Placements were just started from the year I enrolled and many good companies showed up for campus placements. Your overall performance matters alot for the placement. Rest, they don't assure your placements but the company comes to hire you. Do visit the campus before you enroll.
content.Infrastructure: The campus and hostel were amazing. It was made beautifully and everything is built fresh. It was a beautiful and huge campus. The food served in the mess was also good and I still miss the mess food. Every day, you get good food, sometimes it's bad but mostly good. Air-conditioners were also available in the hostel. The campus had every facility and every lab that a student needed.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Graphic Communication Design - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and facilities with good faculty support.

content.Placements: 85% of students were placed in our course, average package offered in course was 5 LPA (approximately). There are many recruiters like lopez design, wipro, delivery, paytm, etc. Top roles offered are: ux designer, assistant designer, cheif designer. 80% students got internship in companies like woodland, lopez design studio and local companies.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities offered are fully free Wi-Fi campus, spacious hostel rooms with twin sharing, good quality food with wide range of dishes, medicine room available and 24 hour first aid available with warden. A good canteen with big menu and great taste. A big ground for football and cricket and also the college has indoor games like table tennis and carrom.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Interior Architecture and Design - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is good, and I guess placements are not much great.

content.Placements: More than 50% of the students can get placed from our course. The highest salary package offered in our course was 6 LPA, and the lowest salary offered starts from Rs. 5,000 per month. Asian Paints is the top recruiting company for our course. I am in my first year, so I don't know about the percentage of students who got internships from our course. Top roles offered in our course are interior and spatial designer, lighting designer and visual merchandiser.
content.Infrastructure: I never visited the college until now due to a pandemic. However, I saw some photos and some feedback about our college, and I came to know that the infrastructure is good. But there is less workshop area in our college. I don't know about the facilities provided in hostels. Quality food is served in the mess and canteen.

admission_process.title: World University of Design Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: World University of Design admission 2025is open. The university offers around 14 courses through seven schools. The programmes are offered at UG, PG, and doctoral levels, including BDes, MDes, and PhD, etc. WUD admission 2025 is open. Applications are invited online through the official website of the university. Admission to all the courses offered byWorld University of Designis entrance-based. The university accepts national-level entrance exam scores and also conducts an entrance test for shortlisting candidates. Read the below article to know more about World University of Design admission, eligibility criteria, selection criteria, and admission process:

World University of Design admissions 2025 are ongoing. Candidates willing to be admitted to any courses at World University of Design can check out the updated information about theWorld University of Design coursesalong with their eligibility criteria and selection criteria in the following table:

Eligibility:Class 12 with a minimum of 50% aggregate in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry
Selection Criteria:NATA/JEE
World University of Design admission is a multi-step process. Find below the admission steps for WUD:
Step 1: WUD Online Application
Candidates can apply online through the official website of the university along with the application fee.
Step 2: Appear for the WUD Aptitude Test

In the next step, candidates need to appear for the aptitude test. The admit cards for this test are issued on the official website of WUD. The selection will be done based on the candidate's performance in the entrance test.
Step 3: WUD Campus Interview

Selected candidates will be eligible to appear in the personal interview conducted by the WUD admission panel. The interview will be related to the field of study selected by the candidates. Creative evidence (portfolio, drawings, photographs, crafts, etc.) in hard copy may also be showcased.
Step 4: WUD Admission Confirmation
A confirmation email will be sent to the selected candidates. The selected candidates need to confirm their seat by paying the course fee.

faqs.question: Can I join World University of Design directly?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot join the World University of Design directly. Firstly, you have to give an aptitude test, and secondly, an on-campus interview will be conducted. After passing both the steps, you can join the university. The World University of Design offers programs and degrees at undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma levels. Built on a culture of creativity & innovation, students enjoy the focus on studio learning, creative process, small class size with direct access to faculty and expert technical resources. To apply for admission, visit the official website of the World University of Design and fill out the application form before the deadline.

faqs.question: Does World University of Design accept NIFT exam score?
faqs.answer: Yes, the World University of Design accepts NIFT exam scores. Valid scores of NIFT, NID, D-Art, CEED, and UCEED exams can be considered in lieu of DAT, and those of CET, CAT, MAT, and XAT in lieu of GAT. Candidates with a good NIFT exam score can apply for admission to the university and may be shortlisted based on their performance for the next stages of the admission process, which include a personal interview and the showcasing of creative evidence such as a portfolio, drawings, photographs, or crafts.

Amity University Kolkata offers a variety of programmes. These courses are offreed at the graduate, postgraduate, and diploma levels. For example, the School of Engineering offers Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.
Amity University Kolkata is famous for BTech and BSc. Below mentioned are some of the courses offered by Amity University Kolkata and their respective eligibility, and Amity University Kolkata fee structure:

placements.overview:
Amity University Kolkata started functioning in the year 2014. It is private university, formed when the West Bengal Act of 2014 passed. The exact place of the university is Kadampukur, Kolkata, and Amity University Kolkata is the 10th university campus formed through the Amity Foundation, which is a non-profit organisation.The University has 70+ departments, and 150+ institutions and centers through which it offers 300+ programmes.

Amity University Kolkata courses are offered to students at the UG, PG, and PhD levels. The university offers various courses to students such as BTech, BSc, BBA, BCA, BCom, MTech, MPhil, MCom, MEd, MBA, etc. Kolkata Amity University has various research collaborations under its name, while it has sanctioned 30 funded projects and submitted 301+ funded projects so far.

Amity University Kolkata offers a variety of programmes. These courses are offreed at the graduate, postgraduate, and diploma levels. For example, the School of Engineering offers Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Professional teachers with good skills.

review_content.Placements: Some of the emerging companies like L&T, Tata Housing, Godrej, and Sobha Developers took part in the recruitment drive of our college nowadays. But during our time of recruitment, only 5 to 8 companies were involved in recruitment. Various professional architects participated in the webinars to provide some chances for doing internships with their network.
review_content.Infrastructure: College events like promotions, cultural, and technical fests are conducted twice or thrice a month. A specific set of penalties and punishments is assigned for all the wrong behavior of us. Hostel premises are liberal, but accurate records are maintained. The usage of mobile phones within specified hours is allowed.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: My experience at Amity University Kolkata is really positive.

review_content.Placements: Percentage of students getting placed is approximately 60 percent in B.Tech computer science. Generally, at Amity University Kolkata students get placed at TCS, Deloitte, EY, SAP, etc. Top role offered in my course is SDE. The highest package is 28 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and average is 5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Campus of the university is not that huge. It has spread over 15 acres of land. There are two academic blocks such as A and E blocks. The campus is located in the outer area of Kolkata. Classrooms are good. The campus is fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi enabled. Campus has a library consists of more than 10,000 books. Different types of labs such as Matlab, seminar halls, etc., are available. There are two canteens present on the campus that serve good quality food to the students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. LL.B (Hons.) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Amity Law School is one of the best private law schools in West Bengal.

review_content.Placements: As this is a law course, majority of students here are not first-generation lawyers and often practice with their parents. Amity provides placements in the corporate sector and is very helpful about it. I am not aware of the highest or lowest package offered. Internships are provided by the college, but there are criteria, and not everyone gets them.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is on point, and the best that money can buy. Library is huge, and an entire spare building is allotted for it. You will find all the books you can imagine. College also provides an online e-library that gives you a subscription to SCC online and manupatra.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Infrastructure is good but academics are not good.

review_content.Placements: Around 60% of students were placed in our course. Other than this, some students were also recruited for irrelevant jobs. The average package was around 5 LPA. The highest package was about 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Accenture, Capgemini, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Our college had world class infrastructure. It provided Wi-Fi campus, big classroom, very furnished labs, and library with lots of books. Quality of hostel was also good. Limited sports facility was available. It had basic medical facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical and Automation Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of campus and academics, good placement for B.Tech.

review_content.Placements: More than 70% of students got placed with a median salary of Rs 50,000 monthly. The highest package was around 7 LPA last year. The lowest was 4 LPA. Average was around 6 LPA. Volvo, Manhindra & Mahindra, Reliance, and Honda were the top recruiters. 100% of students were offered internships by IT companies like TCS, Wipro, etc. Core companies like Reliance, Mahindra, and Tata. Retail, operations, and QC/QA are the top roles along with some R&D.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, functional labs, spacious classrooms, centralized library, and canteen are available. Other high-quality facilities include hostel, ATM, cafe coffee day, water coolers, elevator, centralized air conditioning, clinic, sports complex including gym and swimming pool, basketball court, cricket pitch, football field, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Great college life, average placement. Enjoyed 2 years of fests - Amity hosts the best in Kolkata.

review_content.Placements: 60-70% of students were placed in our MCA course. The highest package was 12 LPA offered by IBM, the average package was 5-6 LPA offered by some startup companies, and the lowest package ranged from 2.8 to 3.5 LPA. As far as I know, IBM was the top recruiting company. The college provides both paid and unpaid internships. For unpaid internships, you must pay the registration fees, and the same applies to paid internships. You may also receive performance-based offers or PPOs.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is easily accessible throughout the Amity campus. The labs and classrooms are very good, and I can say the library is the best I have seen compared to other colleges. The facilities in our hostel are of high quality. The food in the canteen is much better than that in other college canteens, and the prices are affordable for everyone.

paragraphs: Amity University Kolkata admission processstarts with checking academic qualifications and entrance test scores followed by submission of required documents. Students can begin with the registration process followed by selection rounds. Check the step-by-step Amity Kolkata admission process:
Amity University Kolkata Application

Students meet the eligibility requirement can apply online on the official website of the university. Contenders need to pay a non-refundable application fee of INR 1,500. Once the payment is done, students can download their forms for future reference.
Selection Rounds
Students selection are done on the basis of national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, CUET-UG, CAT, MAT, etc. for specific courses. Admission is based on merit in the last qualifying exam.
Admission Confirmation

After completion of the selection rounds, the shortlisted students have to come for document verification. The seat allotment is done based on the performance of the candidates in the selection rounds. Students need to confirm their seat by paying the course fee.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for BTech admission in Amity University Kolkata?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have passed Class 12 with a minimum of 55% aggregate in PCB or PCM are eligible to take admission. hostel_campus.college_name: Amity University Kolkata Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Professional teachers with good skills.
reviews.review_text: College events like promotions, cultural, and technical fests are conducted twice or thrice a month. A specific set of penalties and punishments is assigned for all the wrong behavior of us. Hostel premises are liberal, but accurate records are maintained. The usage of mobile phones within specified hours is allowed.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Amity University Kolkata is really positive.
reviews.review_text: Campus of the university is not that huge. It has spread over 15 acres of land. There are two academic blocks such as A and E blocks. The campus is located in the outer area of Kolkata. Classrooms are good. The campus is fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi enabled. Campus has a library consists of more than 10,000 books. Different types of labs such as Matlab, seminar halls, etc., are available. There are two canteens present on the campus that serve good quality food to the students.

reviews.review_heading: Amity Law School is one of the best private law schools in West Bengal.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is on point, and the best that money can buy. Library is huge, and an entire spare building is allotted for it. You will find all the books you can imagine. College also provides an online e-library that gives you a subscription to SCC online and manupatra.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good but academics are not good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Our college had world class infrastructure. It provided Wi-Fi campus, big classroom, very furnished labs, and library with lots of books. Quality of hostel was also good. Limited sports facility was available. It had basic medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of campus and academics, good placement for B.Tech.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, functional labs, spacious classrooms, centralized library, and canteen are available. Other high-quality facilities include hostel, ATM, cafe coffee day, water coolers, elevator, centralized air conditioning, clinic, sports complex including gym and swimming pool, basketball court, cricket pitch, football field, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Great college life, average placement. Enjoyed 2 years of fests - Amity hosts the best in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is easily accessible throughout the Amity campus. The labs and classrooms are very good, and I can say the library is the best I have seen compared to other colleges. The facilities in our hostel are of high quality. The food in the canteen is much better than that in other college canteens, and the prices are affordable for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: I did a master's from Amity University, Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Amity University, Kolkata, has a huge campus and provides a lot of facilities. There are gallery classrooms, AC, Wi-Fi, a library, and labs. In total, there are 3 canteens on campus. There is also an infirmary on the campus with a nurse and a doctor present. Amity has a yearly sports fest called Sangathan.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, and helpful faculties, but needs a bit of transparent placement process.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostel and college is absolutely amazing. It has top-notch facilities, with good Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, and a huge library with all kinds of books needed for courses. There are three canteens, all serving hygienic and vegetarian food. There are also many shops outside the college that serve non-vegetarian food, which can be brought into the college canteens to sit and eat.

reviews.review_heading: Everything about Amity Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, in fact, one of the best I've seen in Kolkata. Wi-Fi is provided, there are good labs and desktops, and a peaceful library, though it has fewer informative books. Medical facilities include AC rooms. The sports ground is very small, but it is encouraged through several programs such as Sangathan, which is a department-wise sports competition.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure were on point in every aspect or department like multiple A/C or Wi-Fi available, all kinds of labs and classrooms high-quality sports equipment, and facilities with skilled coaches. There was a theatre and also a cafeteria. The hostel was the best in the town with ample facilities and luxury. The food in the cafeteria was good and the most important the medical facilities were 24-hour and we got a separate infirmary.

reviews.review_heading: Eventful college life will make you fall in love with the university.
reviews.review_text: There are good facilities provided by the university. The lab, Wi-Fi, classroom, library, and canteen are top-anotch. There are 3-4 canteen and all have good food with reasonable price. The library is very well maintained. You have a quiet and personal space for each student.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University is home away from home.
reviews.review_text: There is full Wi-Fi connection on campus. The infrastructure of our college is beautiful. The college is full of greenery. Classrooms are spacious and air-conditioned. The whole college is equipped with air-conditioners. The food quality  is good and tasty and they maintain hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: Students can join this college without any hesitation.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are very well-maintained. The library is very big and peaceful. It has a sports complex and other activities. There is a basketball ground and a badminton court in the college. But we do not have any cricket ground but there we can play football in a small area.

reviews.review_heading: There are really good infrastructure and faculty members in the college.
reviews.review_text: Amity University has a library with comfortable and silent surroundings. This university has 5 blocks. The examination block is separate from other blocks and 4 blocks are for classes for different courses. The university has a sports complex with different games.

reviews.review_heading: An honest review of Amity University Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great starting from the Wi-Fi connection, all the items you need for labs. Classrooms are nice. The library is also well-maintained. You would get every book that you would need for your course. Hostel facilities are also awesome. The quality of the mess and canteen is also above average. There are proper medical facilities available and sports and games are given equal attention.

paragraphs: Amity University Mumbai admission is a multi-step process. Students looking for course admission must fill in the application form, pass the selection rounds and pay the application fee. Check the points below to know the detailed admission process:
1- Amity University Mumbai Application Process 2026

The admission process begins by filling the application form through the website. The application fees of INR 1,500 for Mumbai campus is competely waived off. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill out an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity University Mumbai.
2- Amity University Mumbai Selection Process

Amity University Mumbai admissions are both merit and entrance-based. For most of the UG & PG courses, candidates are selected based on merit of the last qualifying exam of previous education. Further, the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Personal Interview round as per course requirements. The students are selected based on Amity PhD Entrance Test +Interview by Faculty Member or All India National Level Competitive Examination or NET (viz. UGC / CSIR -NET in Category 1,2 or 3, ICMR- JRF/SRF, ICAR-AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD), GATE, GPAT, DST – INSPIRE, DBT-JRF etc.
3- The Final Offer Letter

After the completion of all the selection rounds, the final result will be declared. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. Candidates also have to pay a certain amount as per theAmity University Mumbai feesstructure to secure their seats.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are decent, but HR expects students to have extra skills.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at PSG College of Arts and Science.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course is satisfactory and well-maintained. The classrooms are spacious, clean and have proper seating with good ventilation. Most classrooms are equipped with projectors. The Wi-Fi facility is available across the campus, and the speed is pretty okay.

reviews.review_heading: Only a positive comment about this college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is available. Labs are provided for every related course. There is a library with a large number of books. Most of the hostel students are unhappy with the food supplied.

reviews.review_heading: It is an amazing college with so many facilities and with an eco-friendly environment.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: There were different types of hostels. Facilities for improvement in those hostels, including a single cot, bathrooms, and cupboards, are a must. reviews.review_heading: Placement training is just in the name and is not effective.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college and the course because it provides a good quality of education.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities like 2 large food courts, and food will also be of good quality at an affordable price. reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.

Many indoor and outdoor games were being played.

reviews.review_heading: The college is the best to get placed in.
reviews.review_text: Labs are available. The library has a good infrastructure department, which helps us to achieve anything related to our academics. The hostel facility is a bit less. Sports and games are encouraged well among the college. The canteen in the hostel is a little worse.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, best college for M.Sc. in statistics course.

Our own textbooks were also convenient in our college library. We also had a kitchen with fresh snacks and water. Every Saturday, there were performances. There was a separate room/hall for tennis, carrom, and more.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.

The rooms and infrastructure in the hostel are well-maintained the student's login and out registers are well-kept. Students are bound to follow the rules strictly. Mess and the food are neat and ...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in 2025.

Each floor has restrooms for both boys and girls and separate ones for staff members. There are 2 main canteens and 2 snack bars inside and there is also a mini stationary and sprint-out shop inside the college. The student Wi-Fi works well for certain app usage. The library has a variety of books which will be useful for studying.

reviews.review_heading: Completely satisfied with the placements. The canteen is available and extracurricular activities.

There are health centers to help us with sudden injuries. And they give more importance to sports and games like football, basketball, and also dance.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with the money I paid for this college.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very good because of its good faculty, good placements, and very good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Nehru College Coimbatore has huge library facilities, and every department has labs. Classrooms are very big with LED screens for study purposes. The hostel has Wi-Fi facilities. The hostel provides good food and quality food. They also have very good medical facilities and sports centers.

reviews.review_heading: Social interaction plays a more important role in learning and other activities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a beautiful environment and it is very neat and clean. There are a lot of sports activities and clubs in our college. Students can expose the hidden talents and sports activities for certain clubs and sports. The campus was very nice and good.

reviews.review_heading: Many companies like Wipro, Infosys, Cognizant, TCS, and Zifo visit our campus.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are well furnished and maintained. We are providing nutritious vegetarian and non-vegetarian food is provided to the inmates. Gym, library, stores, photocopying, laundry, and free Wi-Fi connectivity are other amenities provided for the convenience of the residents.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a good college.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi: Institutions usually provide Wi-Fi connectivity across the campus, including classrooms, libraries, and hostels.
Labs: Well-equipped labs with modern equipment and software are typically available for courses that require practical experiments and research.
Classrooms: Institutions usually have spacious, well-ventilated classrooms with modern teaching aids like projectors, whiteboards, and audio-visual equipment.

reviews.review_heading: You can join the college for just a degree but do not expect more than this.
reviews.review_text: Facilities for our courses include a food lab and a chemical analysis lab. Cleanliness could be improved; the food lab lacks hygiene. There are 2-3 canteens available inside the campus with average food. We have a huge library where a limited number of books are available for our courses. Classrooms are not very advanced.

reviews.review_heading: Both study and enjoyment are equal here.
reviews.review_text: The classroom facility is good and the labs are also good, but if you're looking for Wi-Fi, this campus is not a Wi-Fi-free campus; only staff can access Wi-Fi. And everyone should be required to get a library card. The library also has two floors. Finally, if you choose a hostel on a college campus, a college bus will come and pick you up and drop you off, and they will also provide food, with a rent of around 85,000 per year.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, nice staff, green campus.
reviews.review_text: Nehru Arts and Science College has well-planned, good infrastructure. Our library has different collections of books. The institution encourages sports and games through well-equipped infrastructure. The college offers hostels for boys and girls. Hostel rooms are well-furnished and maintained.

reviews.review_heading: The Campus Life was our best life and unforgettable memories.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good; there are many labs in the college for each and every course, with separate labs available. Wi-Fi is only available for the faculty members. Classrooms are good and neat, the library is available, and all the books are there. The campus is very good and neat; the faculty members are very supportive and cool.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled but the network facility is not good. Mobile phones are not allowed on our campus. Dress code is mandatory in this college. Our campus maintains discipline strictly. The food served in the canteen is good at affordable prices.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Nehru Arts and Science College.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides excellent infrastructure. The library has more than 2,000 books. Our college is well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has friendly teachers.
reviews.review_text: The food served in the hostel is good and hygienic. Students are safe in the hostel. The hostel rooms are well-maintained and clean. The warden is good. We have a bus facility. The infrastructure of our college is good. We have a canteen. It provides food at affordable prices.

reviews.review_heading: Nehru Arts and Science college is great.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well maintained. They have digital white boards, and projectors In every classroom. Hostel is well maintained, with 24*7 Wi-Fi, daily cleaning, and laundry services. Sports and games are entertained by the teachers, and trained professionals are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Nehru have good infrastructure and a peaceful surrounding.
reviews.review_text: College have good infrastructure and surrounding. Other facilities like canteen, hostel etc. Are available. Our hostel facilities is very nice, maintenance and food are very good and are well maintained in our hostel and college. The classrooms have projector facilities also.

admission_process.title: Hindusthan College of Arts and Science Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: HICAS admission process 2025is both merit-based and entrance-based. HICAS accepts admission on the basis ofentrance testfor specific courses such asMBA, MCA, and PhD. Whereas for remaining courses, direct admission is offered based on the merit of the last qualifying exam of candidates. HICAS application forms can be filled in bothonlineandofflinemodes.
Hindusthan College of Arts and Scienceis affiliated withBharathiar University, Coimbatore. Read the complete article to know more about Hindusthan College of Arts and Science admission.

The institute offers admission to over57 coursesat UG, PG, and PhD levels across various streams, such asArts & Humanities, ScienceandAccounting, and Commerce. Apart from this, HICAS also offers 5 diploma and certificate courses. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria forHICAS courses:

Read More:HICAS Admission PolicyandHICAS Admission Brochure 2025

Hindusthan College of Arts and Science admission consists of multiple steps. HICAS admission begins with an online/ offline registration process. Interested students can check out the following section to learn more about Hindusthan College of Arts and Science admission in detail:
HICAS Application Process

HICAS accepts both online/ offline applications for admission to UG & PG courses. Candidates must fill an application form either on the university's official website or they can submit a hard copy of the application form to HICAS.

For PhD course admission, candidates must apply offline. The candidates who want to apply for M. Phil/ PhD programme are advised to visit the official university website. Candidates can download the application from the website. The candidates have to download two copies of the application and submit the filled in application at college.
HICAS Selection Rounds
For MBA & MCA course, students are admitted based on TANCET scores. Whereas for other UG & PG courses, candidates are selected based on their merit of the last qualifying exam.
HICAS Merit List Release & Fee Payment

Hindusthan College of Arts and Science admission is subjected to the rules of reservation of the Government of Tamil Nadu andBharathiar University, Coimbatore. A partial 50% of the seats are filled as per the reservation policy stipulated by the regulatory bodies and 50% of the seats are filled through Management Quota. The shortlisted candidates will be notified through merit lists. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theHindusthan College of Arts and Science feeto confirm their seats in the university.

reviews.review_heading: It's worth the money. You should give it a try.

individual_reviews.title: T. John Group of Institutions (autonomous) is a college we shouldn't underestimate by looks.

content.Placements: Currently, no such information is available as I am still in the 2nd year. But heard from seniors that placements are pretty average. Not much support is provided. The average package offered ranges from around 3-4 LPA. It's actually not that good. Rest it is our efforts.

individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely not satisfied due to more pressure given by the Principal and staff members.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Greenery with knowledge and wisdom.

content.Placements: Placements in high named companies such as Cipla, etc. Many got placed in high-rated good companies which helps them in building their future with more success. Many got settled in foreign countries with high played salary. Many have built in strong base in India.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are always clean. Bathrooms are maintained with sanity. Our environment is green due to which our mind is always calm. Canteen provides variety and hygienic food. individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college with average placements, good infrastructure, a campus with basic facilities.

content.Placements: Recently, MPHARM and B.Pharma students have been placed in various companies, including MNCs like Mylan Laboratories and Strides. The college helps students secure internships if they are willing to pay a certain amount. If students choose to take an internship outside the college's assistance, the faculty may help them with the details.
content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi facility. They provide basic infrastructure facilities like clean water, smart boards, desks, lawn area, library, laboratories, etc. Classrooms are spacious and have digital boards with good ventilation. There is no girls' hostel on the campus. There is only a boys' hostel, which provides good food. There is a common canteen which provides hygienic food.

individual_reviews.course: B.B.A. in TJC - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied because of good faculty members, placements, and infrastructure.

content.Infrastructure: Classrooms, library, placement training, transport, Wi-Fi, hostel, and canteen facilities are provided by the college. The food is good quality, with breakfast and dinner served in the hostel. Students excelling in sports and games are highly encouraged here.

We have sufficient classrooms. And in the hostel we do have our own hostel. We have 2 hostels with college affiliation. And my hostel was very nice and had a calm atmosphere. The ambience is very good. Every Sunday we have an outing from 7 am to 6 pm.

reviews.review_heading: Studies, sports, and NCC are good.
reviews.review_text: We have a library and labs for MBA and kitchen facilities for BHM and BCA computer labs and big playgrounds and water facilities, washrooms, cleanliness, etc. Hostel is provided for boys inside the college, and hostel for girls is provided outside the college. Medical facilities are not there, but sports and games and events are conducted, and we have a veg and non-veg canteen with a bakery for snacks and a xerox shop for printouts.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of plenty of unwanted rules. But good at teaching.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are available in this college but not up to par, but still, it's okay. Average lab facilities, adequate classes, decent library, etc. are there. The hostel is pretty decent, and the food is above average. Sports activities will be encouraged in the college depending on your performance.

reviews.review_heading: The college life was decent but there were no good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is decent. Sports and games were pretty good. The college canteen provides good food and it was a pretty good experience. The labs were okay; there are many systems but they were lacking A/C. Classrooms were good with smart boards.

reviews.review_heading: A college introduction with experience of 3 years studying in the institutions.
reviews.review_text: The college is big enough, and the classes are spacious with good ventilation and made with multiple windows, accommodating around 100 students. The labs are well-equipped with the necessary requirements, and the college has a hostel for boys with a good mess that provides food at an affordable price.

reviews.review_heading: Reality check before you join.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very old infrastructure, and the washrooms are not well-equipped. The toilets have mugs. Drinking water facilities are available but without glasses. The classrooms are average, and Wi-Fi is not available. The library is good but filled with unwanted stuff.

reviews.review_heading: Prefer to get admission in Pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: The college boasts excellent facilities including well-equipped classrooms, projectors, a spacious lawn area, an auditorium, a library, a computer lab, a canteen, and a hostel serving high-quality food. The campus is adorned with lush greenery, maintained cleanliness, and state-of-the-art laboratories for hands-on learning experiences.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good infrastructure and facilities like classrooms, labs, and a library. The library has all the needed books. The mess provides good food.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Psychology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My best part of my life started in college.

content.Placements: In the M.A. Psychology course at KMV, placements depend a lot on individual skills and interest areas. While core psychology roles may not provide mass placements like technical fields. Many students did get opportunities in counseling, teaching, or internships at mental health centers. A few also prepared for competitive exams or went for higher studies like M.Phil or Ph.D. Internships were usually available in hospitals, NGOs, or with psychologists, which helped in building practical knowledge.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of KMV was quite good. Classrooms were well-organized and had a calm atmosphere for studying. Campus had strong Wi-Fi connectivity. The library was peaceful with a wide collection of psychology books and research materials. The environment was clean and disciplined. The mess food was vegetarian but hygienic and better than many other colleges. College also provided a safe and comfortable space for female students.

hostel_campus.college_name: Kanya Maha Vidyalaya Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description:
Founded in I886, KMV boarding house, ‘Kanya Ashram’, as it was popularly called, is situated within the precincts of the college. The hostel building consists of four hostel wings- Savitri Bhawan, Rai Bahadur Badri Das Hostel, Saraswati Bhawan and New Hostel. Located in lush green and eco-friendly surroundings, the hostel has a provision of accommodation for about 800 girl students.
Furnished with state-of-the-art infrastructure, the Institution provides all modern amenities to the boarders such as water coolers, solar system, T.V, LCD Projector, newspapers. Spacious and airy rooms are fitted with a ceiling fan and a tube light each. In order to ensure pure, uncontaminated and uninterrupted water supply, filters and purifiers have been installed.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of KMV was quite good. Classrooms were well-organized and had a calm atmosphere for studying. Campus had strong Wi-Fi connectivity. The library was peaceful with a wide collection of psychology books and research materials. The environment was clean and disciplined. The mess food was vegetarian but hygienic and better than many other colleges. College also provided a safe and comfortable space for female students.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good and affordable.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the biotech department is very good. There are well-maintained labs and the equipment is also good enough. The classroom and library are well decorated and maintained. Overall, we can say it is very valuable and good. All other facilities are provided on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and facilities are fine.
reviews.review_text: Modern labs with many equipments like spectrophotometer, laminar air flow, autoclave, centrifuge is present in the department. A departmental library continuing many reference and costly books and smart classrooms with projector are present in the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Best autonomous heritage .
reviews.review_text: Our department provides a lot of knowledge about the theoretical as well as practical. They provide internship programs which are compulsory for the students. In the hostel, there is hygienic food as well as washrooms to use. There is home like environment in the college.

reviews.review_heading: KMV is the best with good infrastructure and good faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good and the college provides all the facilities to the students which are really beneficial for the students. Classrooms are very big and they are cleaned everyday. Library is very big with lots of books. Hostel is really good and food is hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college building is good and attractive with a natural environment and greenery. It has a great space for parking both two-wheelers and four-wheelers. There is a separate space for sports, a canteen, a library, and an auditorium.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the faculty members and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are very good and well-ventilated. They have air-conditioners, coolers, and attached washrooms. Common washrooms are cleaned properly. Labs are well-ventilated. Wi-Fi is available in all labs and hostel rooms. All the classrooms are well-ventilated.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of its teachers, good placements, good infrastructure, and hostel facilities.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms are well ventilated. Labs and classrooms are digital. Wi-Fi is available in all classrooms and labs. Many sports are conducted at our college. We always win gold medals in almost all games. Recently, our college conducted a sports day.

reviews.review_heading: This college is worth it for admission.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and digital labs are very good. The atmosphere of our college is very peaceful. Studios of journalism and mass communication have equipment. The English department organises an English festival every year. The college also introduces Certificate courses, NCC camps etc.

reviews.review_heading: I am having a wonderful learning and life-changing experience here.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a lush green campus full of positivity. The service of Wi-Fi is provided. Matlab and practicals are given importance. The library is a rich source of books. Smart classrooms provide a good educational environment. Medical facilities are provided 24 by 7. The quality of food in canteen and mess is good. A lot of opportunities for students interested in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides excellent atmosphere.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. We have other facilities like labs, animation labs, smart classrooms, and a department library. Good and healthy food is served in hostels. There is a special canteen for the hostel. Even the medical facilities provided are very good and are available 24 hours.

reviews.review_heading: Students in Kanya Maha Vidyalaya can learn with joy.
reviews.review_text: The ambience on the campus is great. Labs are air-conditioned. Wi-Fi is also available. The college has a library too, where you can find thousands of books. The college also has a huge auditorium, but as the students are in large number, now the auditorium needs to get enlarged so every student can get their space to sit. Rest of the things are great. You'll also find peacocks here.

reviews.review_heading: There are good infrastructure and best facilities in KMV college.
reviews.review_text: KMV college has very good facilities. There are many facilities like rooms, ground, mess, library, garden and knowledge gaining halls. The best part of our college is food facilities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Autonomous heritage institution to study.
reviews.review_text: Our college campus has most of neat and green environment. Our campus has great network of wi-fi. Each facility is provided to girls whether it is medical or other things. There special classes arranged for those who has interest in sports. Our college also win many prizes in sports category.

reviews.review_heading: Kanya Maha Vidyalaya is one of the best college.
reviews.review_text: In our college, we have smart classes and maths lab. The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Medical facilities are provided 24x7. Our college is one of the best colleges in the sports field.
